abstract: The ultrastructure of eight 7,12-dimethylbenz (a) anthracene (DMBA) or 4-nitroquinoline-N-oxide (4-NQO) induced malignant tumors of placental and uterine origin in the rat were studied. Three of eight tumors had the ultrastructural characteristics of choriocarcinoma. The other five tumors had different fine structures. Two were classified as squamous cell carcinoma, one was as a leiomyosarcoma and the other two were undifferentiated sarcoma.
abstract_ja: DMBAまたは4-NQOにより誘発されたラットの胎盤および子宮起源の悪性腫瘍8例の超微細構造を検討した。8例中3例は絨毛癌の超微細構造的特徴を示した。その他の5例は異なる微細構造を示し、うち2例は扁平上皮癌、1例は平滑筋肉腫、残りの2例は未分化肉腫に分類された。
